column1: # Every parameter and local of the 442 debug functions.
# storage is from the DEMO build. Its local count/types are high-value
# codegen evidence, not a retail spec: helper/API changes can replace
# either, so retail access widths and callee ABI win.
# C_AUTO offsets are frame-pointer relative ($fp == $sp), so the real
# slot is sp + fsize + offset; we print the resolved sp+N.
# A name repeated inside one function is a distinct nested-block scope;
# depth is the lexical block nesting from the 0x90/0x92 records
# (1 = the function body), which is how you tell those apart.
